about: William F. Jones is a top-rated attorney who practices law in Denver, Colorado. William Jones focuses on Civil Litigation: Defense issues. Additionally, he also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: Franchise / Dealership, Business Litigation, Estate & Trust Litigation and Intellectual Property Litigation.

William Jones received Super Lawyers designation for 2015 - 2027. He was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
He became a licensed attorney in 1997. Before practicing law, he attended law school at University of Virginia School of Law and graduated in 1997.
